comment: I don't know what yall are talking about. The class is definitely hard, which is what should be expected if you want to be a good comp sci major. Class participation is enough to get a good grade, and even though he can sometimes be confusing, reading the textbook and going to his office hours should be enough to get you by.

I wish I could copy and paste my CourseEval here. In short, Wibby is the most disliked teacher or professor I've ever encountered. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. The only exception is if you already know Discreet Math or feel capable of mastering the entire course independently. In that case, his relaxed grading style will play to your advantage.

He is a very hard teacher and the slides were often very wordy and confusing. He would often get himself confused which doesn't help when you're teaching a hard subject. Tests were very hard and always had to curve them.
Super, again, super confusing. Might be a nice person but definitely not a good lecturer. Come to his office with your questions about homework and assignments, that helps.
Wibberly was all over the place. But do your homeworks, use the TA  and STUDY. You wont do good without studying.
Terrible teacher, not clear at all, avoid AT ALL COSTS.
Not super clear, kind of jumps around in class. very happy I took calc in high school or else I would imagine it would be very hard bc he does not explain things a lot
He is very nice and helpful. It's an easy class and you can always earn many many many bonus point!!!

If you have taken calc before, are a math major, or are in b-school you will be fine. If you aren't AVOID.I went to his office hours every day with questions and he wasnt helpful. Writes mean things on tests like "Can you even do math?" impatient and rude.
He is awesome!!! Best cal teacher ever!!!!!! take his class, easy A! A lot of bonus~~~~
Leo is very helpful and he is very nice to help students. He will give a lot of bonus!Take his course!!!!!!
Wibberly is the man!!! Love his class extremely! If you have learned AP math before, this course can be very easy. He will give a lot of extra bonus!Take his class, work hard, you will get A
MR.WIBBERLY is a really nice guy!!!!!He is really helpful!!!If you haven't taken CAL before, it will be hard to take his class. However, if you took CAL before, his class is the best choice!!!

he is a very helpful teacher and he is a nice guy! BUT if you don't have CAL backgrounds, it might be difficult for you to take his class! He gives students so many chances to make the score up up up!!!!I love him!!!!
He's an awful teacher! I took Calc in high school and had As and in his class he actually made everything I had already learned confusing. If you have never taken calc before DO NOT TAKE HIM.
Hard class! Love math and got all A's in high school.  All of the test grades I got from him have been D's. Test ridiculously harder than homework.

He is an okay professor for calc. Does not spend a lot of time going over material, so read the textbook. Goes over some material very quickly. Some test questions are unnecessarily hard for what we have done in class.  A short quiz once a week, 3 tests, 3 EASY projects. It is good because you get a lot of points.  Allowed a cheat sheet on tests.

Not recommended as a calc I prof. His lectures are not clear and teaching yourself everything isn't fun when you have a busy schedule. He is good with help, but since lectures were not enjoyable, I wouldn't recommend this prof.

Great guy, easy to talk to, willing to help. However, if you are not a math person, for the love of god, don't take Wib! He is very hard to understand and thinks that all of his students are math majors. Really a great guy to be honest. He's a lot of fun to talk to and wants you to do well. Just don't take his class if Calc is not your thing!

I really like Dr. Wibberly. He was interesting during class, he always explained thoroughly the sections we were reviewing, and he was open to any questions. He gives relatively easy weekly quizzes and drops the two worst quiz grades. Tests can get hard. Since I have taken Calculus before I think he's a perfect teacher for a recap of it.

This guy is an awful teacher.  He understands calculus but has no clue how to teach what he's talking about.  Allows a cheat sheet for the tests but gives one quiz per week. If you want to teach yourself calc, take this guy

Leo goes on mathematical tangents and is quite quirky at times but knows how to make you laugh. Easy projects, reasonable quizzes and occasionally hard tests. if you have never taken calc before you'll need a tutor but thats the way it is with all 211s. agreeably one of the better of the calc I teachers.

Class was relatively easy. If you do the homeworks and the problem sets you should be able to get an A. There was one very easy project (on which most people got a 100!). So he definitely tries to make it easy for you.

I will admit that for those who have not taken calculus before, this class can be difficult. He is a very smart man but sometimes doesn't always explain things the best. If you show an effort and that you are trying he will help you and re-explain things and that will help your grade. Let's you drop 2 HW's out of about 8.

Dr. Wibberly is really hard, but despite what people say... he's a really good teacher. I had him during mayterm and I thought he was great. If you go in before class he will basically give you all the answers to the homework and will reteach you how to do everything. If you take him, you have to be very prepared to do the work and listen in class.
very hard class.  you're allowed a cheat sheet, but still not too helpful on tests and quizzes.

He teaches the material in class similar to the way the book presents it in the beginning of a chapter, but his [sometimes boring] explanations make a lot more sense. Goes over homework and of the 6 homework grades 2 can be dropped. 3 quizzes and you are allowed a cheat sheet. Gives you a fair chance to do really well.
Teacher should be fired. Grades are the only thing that matter not personal evolution in math. AVOID this **** at all times

Super smart guy but can simply not teach it to some students(me). I needed to take this for my business requirement (may term) and I  hate it. Tests + Final are 65 % of the grade so pretty much no chance in passing. Ok homework and popp quizzez are told when they will be given but that is not enough. I will get F unless he gives me D- Good luck

Probably one of the easiest courses this school offers. He tells you when the homework wont even be collected (90% of the time), the tests are a joke, you can bring a full cheat sheet to all tests, almost impossible not to get an A+ in this class. If you suck at Math and need the requirement or just want an east A,take this class,it wont disappoint

If you took calc in high school, you should be ok; if not, avoid him at all costs.  Scary smart, does missles for the gov't... just can not fathom that some people are not good at math.  very helpful, but when he helps he may assume he has taught you well enough up to that point to understand what you're seeking help with, which is not always true.

Good teacher, especially for math.  very smart and pretty good at explaining everything.  i would recommend him, grades are 4 quizzes, final, a few homeworks that he collects but he'll tell you when that will happen.
Ridiculously easy if you went to high school and paid even an ounce of attention.  Maybe he's not the greatest teacher but the way he grades combined with the textbook got me an A+
good guy- very nice and helpful, ridiculously easy.  joke class.  but i would be worried if it was actually difficult material... he doesnt come off as very quick, or at least able to relate.

fair grader and theres always opportunities for bonus points. very helpful too! stayed til 11pm one night just to help me and a few classmates with an assignment. people complain about him being a bad teacher, but i just think calc is a hard subject, he's not the problem.
Not very interesting teacher. I didnt have a problem with his teaching methods. I loved his grading system. Very fair and lots of opportunity for bonus. Very easy grader.
He is a terrible teacher and should be fired. By the way tho, Wibberly is an ok guy in small doses.
whatever.
Good teacher, knows his stuff, if you have some sort of understanding about calculus course is pretty good and managable... do the homeworks and projects well and your set.

I took him at VCU. Agreed, he is not a good teacher, but he grades very fairly. The key is partial credit on the exams. Dont need the correct answer, just show you know how to get there. I highly reccomend if you need to pass Calc...

Horrible if you've had a background in Calc...can't imagine if you haven't.  Terribly intelligent but can't teach for his life.  Do not take his class, it only stresses you out and confuses you to insanity.

A really good teacher. He might not be extremely clear to people who have never dealt with calculus, but this lies more in the difficulty of the course not him as a teacher.  A fair grader and tests you on the calculus not the workup.  Would highly recomm

smart guy but terrible teacher. unless you have previous knowledge in calc i wouldn't recommend him b/c the class is more of a 'teach yourself what you need to know' type deal and text book is not helpful. pretty easy grader though which is a plus.

really unclear especially when going over the homework.. goes off on too many unrelated topics and when explaining the related topics doesn't follow through...works on patriot missles but can't teach basic calculus
He is unclear in explaining things and what he goes over is not the homework.  Three quizzes a semester and collects and grades a forth of the homework.
